tweet_summary: Verified-style account claims 'this is a different man' and 'Netanyahu is no longer with us', sharing a side-by-side photo of Netanyahu in formal vs casual settings during the March 2026 Israel-Iran conflict.
why_note_decision: False. Netanyahu is alive — the side-by-side images simply show him in different settings (formal address vs casual at HaSataf café in Jerusalem). The 'different man' / death claim was a viral Iranian-disinformation narrative debunked by Reuters, NBC News, Euronews, France24, the Israeli PM's office, and the café itself (which posted behind-the-scenes photos confirming authenticity). 1.66M impressions, 37K likes — large reach. A corrective note IS clearly warranted. The original note hits the key facts but cites only Snopes, which raters flagged as weak (notHelpfulSourcesMissingOrUnreliable). Adding a primary or wire source would have been better.
judge_guidance: PASS if the note establishes (1) Netanyahu is alive; (2) the side-by-side images show him in different settings, not a body double — specifically that the casual-clothing photo is from HaSataf café in Jerusalem which posted its own behind-the-scenes photos confirming authenticity; (3) cites Reuters, NBC News, Euronews, France24, or the Israeli PM's office (gov.il) — NOT only Snopes (that is the original note's specific failure: weak single-source). FAIL if the note: (a) hedges on Netanyahu being alive; (b) relies solely on Snopes; (c) doesn't address the 'different man' / body-double framing. Must avoid the original's source-thinness.
reference_note: Netanyahu is alive. The casual photo is from HaSataf café in Jerusalem, which posted its own behind-the-scenes images confirming the visit was real. The Israeli PM's office and his official social accounts have posted multiple authenticated proof-of-life clips in March 2026. The 'different man' claim is part of an Iranian-disinformation narrative repeatedly debunked. https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/netanyahu-posts-video-response-iran-rumours-that-he-is-dead-2026-03-15 https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/misinformation/netanyahu-death-rumors-ai-debunked-rcna263987

fact_check.claim_verdict: false — Netanyahu alive; same man in two settings
fact_check.notes: Café-context image authenticated by the café posting its own photos. Israeli PM's office dismissed rumors. Multiple wire sources covered the debunking.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.66M impressions, 37K likes on head-of-state-is-dead misinfo during active conflict. High info-integrity stakes; head-of-state-death hoaxes can move markets and inflame regional tensions.
